summary_en: 1,000,000 common shares (3.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be cancelled effective 2026-09-30. Shares acquired under May 2026 buyback authorization (¥2.0B limit, ¥331M cumulative as of June 2026). Cancellation to enhance per-share value and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of cancellation of treasury shares (cancellation of treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: United Arrows resolved on 2026-07-30 to cancel 1,000,000 treasury shares (ordinary stock) effective 2026-09-30, representing 3.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury. These shares are being acquired under a May 2026 buyback authorization (¥2.0B limit, ToSTNeT-3 method, acquisition period May 2026–August 2026). As of 2026-06-30, the company had acquired 134,400 shares for ¥331M. The company stated it reassessed the need for additional treasury holdings and determined that existing holdings suffice for foreseeable capital-allocation needs; accordingly, the newly acquired shares will all be cancelled. The cancellation aims to enhance per-share value through reduction in issued shares and to improve capital efficiency and shareholder value.
